tender.description:
Lancaster University is looking to re-tender its Specialised Cleaning Services and aims to establish a framework with up to 3 - 5 suppliers on each lot. The purpose of this Framework Agreement is to ensure the University has a sustainable supply of contractors to meet workload demands and achieves best value for money.
The Framework Agreement is split into the following lots:
Lot 1 - Full Building Deep Cleaning
Lot 2 - Emergency and Hazardous cleaning
Lot 3 - Bulk en-suite bathroom pod deep cleaning
Lot 4 - Bulk oven deep cleaning
Lot 5 - Upholstery, curtains, mattresses and carpets
Lot 6 - External Cleaning
Lot 7 - Weekend and weekday cleaning and support
Lot 8 - Ad hoc/general cleaning support
A selection process will take place based on the responses to the Invitation to Participate document which includes the Procurement Specific Questionnaire (PSQ). 
Up to 8 suppliers will be shortlisted for each Lot and invited to tender. The tender evaluation will comprise a quantitative and qualitative assessment as part of the ITT (Invitation to Tender).

frameworkAgreement.buyerCategories: This Framework may be used by contracting authorities and other eligible customers located in the United Kingdom, British Overseas Territories and Crown Dependencies existing on 06/10/2026. Eligible customers include central government departments, executive agencies, non-departmental public bodies, assembly-sponsored public bodies, local authorities, emergency services (including police, fire, ambulance, maritime and coastguard services), NHS and healthcare organisations, educational establishments (including schools, academies, colleges and universities), housing associations and registered social landlords, national parks, hospices, charities, voluntary and community sector organisations, citizens advice bodies, and any other public sector body permitted to access the Framework in accordance with applicable procurement legislation.
frameworkAgreement.description:
Call-Off Contracts may be awarded using any one of the following methods outlined below. 
1.Direct Award (Award Without Competitive Selection) 
2.Rapid Request for Quote (Rapid RFQ) 
3.Further Competition 
The ultimate responsibility for selecting the most appropriate and compliant route for a specific requirement rests with the Customer. The onus will be on the Customer to carry out their own due diligence before selecting which method to use. The Customer will determine the requirement, specification and award, based on the Most Advantageous Tender (MAT) 
Direct Award (award without a competitive selection): 
This Framework permits Direct Award, defined under the Procurement Act 2023 as awarding a Call-Off Contract without conducting a new competitive selection procedure. A Direct Award may only be used where the Customer can identify the Most Advantageous Tender (MAT) using only the information and scores submitted at Framework award, without requesting any new pricing, clarification, or qualitative information from Suppliers. 
Permitted Direct Award Methods 
Customers may use any of the following objective, pre-published Direct Award methods. The Customer must choose one method before reviewing Supplier capability for their requirement. 
1. Overall Framework Ranking (Quality + Price Combined Score) 
2. Highest Total Quality Score 
3.  Lowest Overall Price/Highest Commercial Advantage 
4.  Highest Score in a Specific Evaluation Question 
5. Partial-Service Selection (Specific Services from the Pricing Schedule)
Rapid RFQ 
A Rapid RFQ is a streamlined competitive process appropriate for low-complexity or tightly defined requirements where essential criteria can be specified as Pass/Fail, and price acts as the ultimate determinant among compliant Suppliers. 
Further Competition
A Further Competition process is used where Customers carry out a competition for the award of a Call-Off Contract.

tender.title: Communal Entrance Doors Qualifying Long-Term Agreement
tender.description:
VIVID Housing Limited is seeking to appoint a suitably qualified and experienced contractor to enter into a Qualifying Long-Term Agreement (QLTA) for the Communal Doors Installation and Replacement Works, across its housing portfolio.
The scope of the agreement includes the survey, design, manufacture, supply, installation, replacement of communal entrance doors.
The Contract will include a range of door types and associated components, including steel, aluminium, timber, composite and UPVC door sets, glazing, curtain walling and door entry access control systems.
All works must comply with current Building Regulations, relevant British Standards, fire safety requirements, accessibility requirements, and Secured by Design standards.
The appointed contractor will be responsible for carrying out property surveys, consulting with residents where required, manufacturing and installing compliant door sets, and ensuring minimal disruption to residents during delivery of the works.

additionalClassifications.description: Installation of doors and windows and related components

tender.title: Star Academies - Building Cleaning Services - The Valley Leadership Academy
tender.description:
The Trust (Star) is looking to appoint a single Supplier for the supply of building cleaning services at The Valley Leadership Academy.  
Star’s objective is to create a clean and professional learning environment to support our pupils’ education provision through both day-to-day cleaning, and deep cleaning provision throughout school holidays. 
The supplier selected will be able to provide building cleaning services (excluding external window cleaning) as detailed in Schedule 1 - Specification, for a maximum of 4 years.  Whilst the tender will be used as a basis for future works and pricing, the Trust are looking to engage a supplier who will work collaboratively and tailor their approach, so that they are able to meet the specific needs of the Trust and driving cost savings on an ongoing basis.  More detailed specification requirements are outlined in Schedule 1 - Specification.
Currently this provision is managed by an outsourced provider.
This Procurement is being conducted in accordance with the Act using the Open Procedure. This document describes how the Procurement will be conducted, including details of the associated Procurement timetable, participation and award criteria
